title: Little Vast Adventure
description: A modpack created with the intent of providing the best experience possible for my friends on school, as it will be their first interaction with the vast world of Minecraft Mods.
body:
**With the intent of providing the best experience that my friends from school shall have on the first time they interact with the vast world of Minecraft mods, I created this modpack.**

**This modpack have mods choosen by hand that should add some interesting features to spice the vanilla gameplay.** (Credit goes to their respective authors)

**It adds over a 128 mods! (half of them are performance mods)**

### Some of the mods add 
- Guns (no magic, only classic freedom)
- Backpacks (easy storage moving)
- Artifacts (new relic for more power!)
- Bosses (challeging and hard)
- MC Dungeons Armor and Weapons (for those that want a challenge)
- EMI (easy recipe viewer with some addons)
- Origins (choose your origin and a class, along with a size!)
- Better Combat (easy combat, just hold down to attack!)
- Even a storage system! (Tom's Simple Storage)
- And many more, try them!


<details>
<summary>Some mods to improve performance:</summary>

- Sodium (the best performance mod that let's you easy change some features of the game to better run it)
- Sodium Extras (add more options to Sodium!)
- Debugify (fix some bug's in Minecraft)
- CullLeaves (better rendering for leaves)
- EntityCulling (dont render the entity that you can't see, improving performance)
- Ferrite Core (optimeze memory for the game)
- GpuTape (memory leak fix)
- ImmeadiatllyFast (fix and improve some aspect's so the game run's faster!)
- Krypton (improves the network efficiency)
- Lithium (lightining perfomance mod)
- ModernFix (fix various bug's and implement some features!)
- Redirector ("reduces the memory usage by preventing unnecessary creation of enum value arrays." Creator description)
- ParticleCore (improves performance of particles)
- And many more (really)

</details>

The modpack doesnt change many aspect of the mods, only some configs are changed, so if you have a question about a certain mod in the modpack, search for the name of the mod on the internet, aswell the version and loader you're playing.

**The credits of the mods, as well the author of them, goes strictly to themselves.**
